An Essay On The Psychology of Invention: This book is cited in Image and Reality: Kekule, Kopp... for recounting the stories regarding 'Isaac Newton, Joseph Priestley, Carl Friedrich Gauss, Alfred Wallace, Dmitrii Mendeleev, Sigmund Freud, Hermann von Helmholtz, Svante Arrhenius, Albert Einstein, Louis de Broglie, Enrico Fermi, Otto Loewi, Linus Pauling, James Watson, John Nash, Richard Feynman, and many others.'
Investigative Pathways: Patterns and Sta: This book gives some accounts of various 'Eureka moments', particularly on pp. 172-88. It is cited as such in 'Image and Reality'
Die Philosophie des Unbewussten by Eduar: This is an interesting German piece on creative genius. Translated to French as Philosophie de l'Inconscient https://archive.org/details/philosophiedeli00hartgoog/page/306/mode/2up
Psychology de l'Invention par Frederic P: A seemingly solid work on creative psychology. https://archive.org/details/psychologiedelin00paul/page/n5/mode/2up
Essai sur le Genie dans l'Art par Gabrie: A long work by Seailles which seems to treat extensively on the spiritual or unconscious nature of innovation. https://archive.org/details/essaisurlegenied00seai/page/n3/mode/2up
